decisions.reason: The exact bound transitions (lines 17,18,19,23 all sharing trigger human_steering_cmd_nor_brake_pressed_nor_in_auto_final and setting R45RouteToken=7; line 26 AutonomousMode->HumanDrivingMode guarded R45RouteToken==7) show the three NL-required causes are internally distinguished at the point where the token is set (three separate inner transitions from three separate inner states/substates), even though the outer edge collapses to a single guard check.
